hook.name: EigenGameHook
hook.description: Burns a fixed percentage of the pool token (currency1) on every swap via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. For token-specified swaps the fee is taken in beforeSwap; for token-as-unspecified-output swaps it is taken in afterSwap. The burn rate (burnFeeBps) is immutable and set at deployment. Liquidity is managed exclusively by a single authorized address.
